create_ase_read_dataset: create an AseReadDataset to load ASE-readable files from a directory using a glob pattern
create_ase_read_multi_dataset: create an AseReadMultiStructureDataset to read multiple structures from trajectory files like .traj or .xyz
create_ase_db_dataset: create an AseDBDataset to connect to one or more ASE databases and load atomic structures
apply_one_tags_transform: apply the apply_one_tags function to set all atom tags to 1 for models like GemNet-OC
connect_ase_db: use AseDBDataset.connect_db to connect to an ASE database with optional readonly and lock settings
